reading_rule: Consume each row as a premise or falsifier before proof search. A result implied by a row is dominated; use the stronger row and continue toward the parent theorem. Route choice remains unrestricted.

results.exact_statement: Even the measured statistics of these orbits are not generic. For #257 the margin minima decay like c/N, the generic shrinking-target law, yet the 21-chain minimum reaches 8.07e-7 at N about 1.3e5, five to ten times CLOSER to the boundary than the 1/N null; the probe itself flags that a larger run is needed to decide trend versus fluctuation. So a generic-orbit heuristic is not even a reliable guide here, let alone a proof.
results.hypotheses: Finite computational structure probe, 2026-08-22; the probe records its own open question about the 5M run.
supersedes: generic-orbit heuristics applied to the #257 margin statistics
results.why_it_matters: It is the sharpest available hint that the five orbits share a mechanism: one of them measurably deviates from the generic law in the direction that would make escape easier.
